༈thun mong gi sngon 'gro rin po che'i pra khrid bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: thun mong gi sngon 'gro rin po che'i pra khrid bzhugs so/ / bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las skye dgu kun gyi dpal/ /dgongs pa brda dang bsnyan brgyud rin chen la/ /dad brgya'i 'dab stong g.yo bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' gsang rgya che las/ /kun gyi rtse mo gsang ba bla na med/ /de yi nges don zangs kyi ye ge las/ /sems sbyong don khrid snying po'i yang zhun bri/ / 'dir theg pa kun gyi mthar thug /gsang ba bla na med pa'i skor las/ thun mong gi sngon 'gror nges pa'i dang po bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sems sbyong ba ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ yid dam mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung dang bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar bsams la/ yid kyis phyag 'tshal dang mchod pa byas pas/ sku'i cha shas nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ /rang gi lus kyi phyi nang khyab/ /sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsams la/ /gdangs snyan pos skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ snang srid bla ma'i zhing khams su gsal btab nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /des ni byin rlabs dngos su 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / de nas maṇ+ḍal la sems sbyong ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod de/ phyi ri rab gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi zhing khams dag pa na lha dang mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs par 'byor ba/ nang 'og min gyi dkyil 'khor dag pa na mchod pa'i sprin gyis spras pa/ gsang ba rang byung gi ye shes dag pa na dgongs klong ting 'dzin gyi rol pas brgyan par dmigs te/

phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal chen po'am/ gling bzhi rgyan 'gyur la sogs pa 'bul lo/ /des ni tshogs gnyis khyad par can rdzogs nas yon tan rlabs po che 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba la sems sbyong ba ni/ 'di ltar sems can tsam gyi khams la bsam nas/ rang gis dal ba brgyad/ 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob pa ni dbul pos nor bu rnyed pa bas kyang ngo mtshar che bar bltas te/ snying nas chos la 'bad dgos snyam du bsam mo/ /des ni spro ba skyes nas chos kyi snod du rung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas mi rtag pa la sems sbyong ba ni/ phyi dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba sna tshogs lo zla tshes grangs skad cig thang cig mi rtag pas kyang 'chi bar nges la/ nang phung po'i 'gyur ba rgas gzhon dang lang tsho yol bas kyang sha rus dang skra sen bral zhing 'chi bar nges pa/ gsang ba 'byung bzhi sdud pa 'chi kha'i snang ba dang bar do bsams te 'chi bar nges pa la bsam pa'o/ /des ni skyo shas drag pos chos la bskul ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas 'khor ba bde sdug la bsam te rgyu 'bras blang dor la sems sbyong ba ni/ dmyal ba'i tsha grangs/ yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro glen lkug / mi skye rga na 'chi/ lha min 'thab rtsod/ lha 'chi 'pho ltung ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad sngon mi dge ba bcu byas pa las byung bas spang dgos/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba thams cad dge ba bcu la sogs pa spyad pa las byung bas blang dgos snyam du bsam pa'o/ /des ni dge sdig blang dor du shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas dad pa la sems sbyong ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang gong ma rnams kyi yon tan la mos pas dad pa dang*/ sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po can du shes pas dag snang khyad par du bsgom pa'o/ /des ni snod las su rung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / de nas snying rje la sems sbyong ba ni/

sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas pha ma drin can yin pa la/ 'khor ba na 'khyams shing da dung thar mi shes chos kyi snang ba dang bral ba 'di snying re rje/ bdag gi bde bas 'di dag bde bar gyur la/ 'di dag gi sdug bsngal bdag la smin zhing*/ bdag gi dge bas 'di dag 'khor ba las myur du thar par shog cig /snyam pa sems can gcig nas kun gyi bar bsgom pa'o/ /des ni tha ེ ga chen gyi lam du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas rmi lam sgyu ma la sems sbyong ba ni/ 'di ltar yul du snang ba'i chos thams cad mdang gi rmi lam dang 'dra ba med pa gsal snang tsam ste/ ji ltar snang ba'i dus na bden par ma grub la/ lus ngag sems su snang ba'i chos kyang med cing snang ba sgyu ma stong pa'i rang bzhin te/ phyi nang gi yul sems thams cad bden stong rmi lam sgyu mar bsgom pa'o/ / des ni chos dang gang zag gi bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / de nas mi rtog pa'i thabs khyad par can la sems sbyong ba la gnyis las/ rlung gi pra khrid ni/ lus chos bdun las/ mjing pa cung zad dgyed de/ rtsa gsum gyi mar sna lte 'og nas dbu mar gug pa/ yar sna mdzod spu las ro rkyang dkar dmar gnyis sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi nang*/ dbu ma tshangs bug la zug pa'i/ sna bug nas rlung du ba ltar phyir song je ring las/ nang du 'ong dus brtan g.yo thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur pa tshur rngubs ro rkyang dbu mar gyur pa la sems la rlung yang dal bus bzung bar bya'o/ des ni gsal stong mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas thig le'i pra khrid ni/ lte ba'i rtsa nang na a thung las me 'bar bas/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu/ dngas ma dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang lus nang kun rim gyis gang*/ bde phri li li ba las snying ga na baṃ sran ma tsam la sems bzung nas yun ring du bsgoms pa'i mthar/

je chung je phra las cir yang bltar med pa'i ngang der glod la bsgom pa'o/ /des ni bde stong mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de ltar mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas/ /yi ge grangs mang dag las 'thor ba rnams/ / 'dir gcig bsdus te thun mong sngon 'gror bkod/ /dge bas 'gro kun mngon par byang chub shog /thun mong gi sngon 'gro rin po che'i pra khrid ces bya ba/ theg pa rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ 'od zer sprin gyi nags nang*/ kun tu bzang po'i khang bzangs/ zla ba chu shel gyis 'tsher bar bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11) thun mong gi sngon 'gro rin po che'i pra khrid/ -PAGE 128--PAGE 131--PAGE 127-
